user.title: Connect to ZTE H186 Modem
user.description: Enter the IP address and web credentials for your ZTE H186 DSL modem.

data_description.host: The modem's LAN IP address or hostname (default 192.168.10.2).
data_description.password: The password for the modem's web interface.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ZTE H186 Modem
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for your ZTE H186 modem.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate ZTE H186 Modem
reauth_confirm.description: The modem at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current username and password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the modem. Verify the IP address and network reachability.

abort.already_configured: This ZTE H186 modem is already configured.
abort.wrong_device: This is not the modem that was set up. Check the address, or remove the entry and add the modem again.
abort.not_supported: The device did not answer as a ZTE H186 modem.

init.title: ZTE H186 Options
init.description: Configure the polling interval for DSL line statistics.

auth_failed.message: The ZTE H186 modem at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Please re-authenticate.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the ZTE H186 modem at {host}. Check that it is reachable.

update_timeout.message: Timed out while fetching DSL statistics from the ZTE H186 modem at {host}.

protocol_error.message: The ZTE H186 modem returned an unexpected response: {error}

wrong_modem.message: The modem at the saved address is a different one (serial number ending {found}, expected {expected}). Its data is not mixed into this entry. Check the address or reconfigure the entry.

duplicate_modem.message: This modem is already managed by the entry "{title}". Remove this duplicate entry.
